title: Raku Workshops
source_quote:
Raku Workshops
Looking for a fiery clay experience? Participants ages 18+ can join a weekend raku firing session to learn this Japanese glazing technique and participate in live firings. Find an upcoming session here.
evidence_sentence: The homepage lists raku workshops where adults participate in live firings.
evidence_quote: Participants ages 18+ can join a weekend raku firing session to learn this Japanese glazing technique and participate in live firings.
summary: Weekend raku firing sessions open to adults 18 and up. See their website for upcoming dates and registration.
